## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: narrow leadership (Top 5 all Technology) and mixed sector internals with defensive/commodity sectors weak, so reduce conviction and be selective.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing pockets of strength: MNST (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND. Materials positive on the week: select names up, e.g., NEM in news (see sentiment).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -7.78%) BELOW TREND. Utilities weak overall; Financials trending down: JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +14.80% | 1M: +24.49%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +13.64%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology); implies concentration risk.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: SLB (1W: -6.41% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION, EOG (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -6.58% | 1M: -10.28%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -7.78%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -3.08%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (multiple large-cap names show 1W vs 1M sign differences such as SLB, V, MO) — tactical caution; watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology strong but concentrated: NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +11.27%) ABOVE TREND; sector breadth supportive on the week but leadership narrow (Tech dominated).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials weak this week: JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +3.41%) CORRECTION — breadth showing internal stress, not a leadership source.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare soft: UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND (confirming bullish news), JNJ (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND — mixed with select strength around UNH.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor high-conviction Technology leaders while keeping position sizes tight given narrow leadership; reduce exposure to weak Energy and select Financials showing breakdown. Style: Growth/momentum tilt but narrow and transitional — monitor for dispersion.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: +14.04% | 1M: +42.14%) ABOVE TREND but negative news — watch for distribution, XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +6.30% | 1M: +21.99%) — leadership concentration. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -5.04% | 1M: -1.38%) and Financials (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -0.64%) — watch for follow-through.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA for continuation above this week's breakout high to confirm ongoing ABOVE TREND momentum; monitor AAPL for sustained closes above recent support (to validate ABOVE TREND). Watch JPM for failure to reclaim short-term range (would reinforce BELOW TREND). Monitor ORCL for price reaction to negative headlines despite strong weekly gains.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (+75): UnitedHealth beats and raises guidance; UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. EOG (+60): Earnings beat; EOG (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for fundamental follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (-50): Layoff/AI cost concerns; ORCL (1W: +14.04% | 1M: +42.14%) ABOVE TREND — price diverging from negative headlines, risk of distribution. CVX (-45): Scrutiny on margins; CVX (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -4.59%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a growth/momentum tilt given narrow Tech leadership. AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated leadership and several sentiment/price divergences (ORCL, EOG) — watch for trend breaks and news-confirmation.
